title: Trollbox
subtitle: On-chain chat on the BitShares blockchain.
intro: Messages are posted on-chain from your account and visible to everyone. The sender pays a small network fee per message, which keeps spam out.
probeUnsupported: This node does not run the chat history service, so past messages cannot be shown here. Posting still works from any node; switching to a supported node makes history visible.
probeError: The connected node did not answer. Check your connection and retry.
noSupportedNode: None of the known nodes support chat history right now. Try again later.
messagesEmpty: No messages in {{channel}} yet — be the first.
waitingForNode: Message history appears once a supported node is selected.
channelsSubtitle: Pick a channel below. Each channel is its own conversation.
composerLogin: Log in to post on-chain messages.
sendTitle: Prepare the message for signing in Beet
errorTooLong: Message is {{over}} bytes over the size limit ({{max}} bytes).
composerHintLoggedOut: Posting as {{user}} to {{catalog}} would cost a small network fee.
blockConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to block this account? You won't see their messages anymore.
attachButton: Attach asset, pair, pool or offer
attachGone: Attachment no longer exists on-chain — pick again.
attachTypeDesc: Pick what to attach — only one item per message.
attachTypePoolHint: An existing pool for two assets
attachNoPools: No pools exist for this asset pair.
attachNoOffers: No credit offers available right now.
riskContent1: Every message is written by a stranger: there is no moderation and nothing is verified — assume hostile intent.
riskContent2: Usernames, avatars and lifetime jewels prove nothing — scammers impersonate known accounts and witnesses.
riskContent3: Never share private keys, brain keys or passphrases with anyone, for any reason.
riskBlock: If someone posts malicious content, block them to hide their messages.
riskLinks1: Don't follow links or attachment actions blindly — verify asset IDs yourself, scam assets reuse familiar symbols.
riskLinks2: Never send funds or sign anything just because a message says so — always inspect signing requests first.
riskLinks3: Barter and credit content is an invitation, not a guarantee — check the counterparty, amounts and escrow terms on-chain first.
riskPerm1: Posts are public, permanent and tied to your account — never post personal or sensitive information.
riskPerm2: Assume anything you post stays visible forever.
attachNotAllowedChannel: This attachment can't be posted in this channel.
